content_data.meeting_title: Cross-Departmental Working Group on AI Ethics and Data Governance
agenda_items: Presentation of preliminary findings from the 'Explainable AI in Network Management' study.
Identification of potential ethical risks in new data collection methodologies.
Discussion on the implications of upcoming compliance frameworks for ongoing research projects.
key_decisions: Mandate a pre-submission ethical review for all research projects involving novel data processing techniques.
action_items: All research leads to submit a brief impact assessment of new data collection methods on compliance by the end of the following month.
Professor Elara Vance to coordinate with legal department for a briefing on upcoming EU regulations within the next month.
